tag: v1.3.0
commit: 9ec050d3269da318380a264d8269f0d904f8aef8 (tag v1.3.0 object, commit type)
source: gh api repos/caomengxuan666/cxxmcp/tarball/v1.3.0 (tarball sha256 6bb3a6a5b061aa7319c09d1ab1def0fc18091f94aa5bfff022a3a9a792b45ac6)
repo: https://github.com/caomengxuan666/cxxmcp (MIT, LICENSE copied unchanged)
vendored: the stdio client path only: the client core and the child-process stdio transport, the JSON-RPC serializer, the core result/async helpers and the protocol models they include, plus nlohmann/json 3.12.0 and tl/expected they depend on. src/process_stdio_transport.cpp, src/stdio_transport.cpp and src/transport_adapter.cpp are compiled only because client.cpp refers to their classes in Client::connect_stdio; gm calls neither and speaks over its own transport (native/components/mcpclient/transport.cpp), which is the only transport it passes to Client. Layout: sdk/include and sdk/*/include become include/, third_party becomes include/, sdk/*/src becomes src/.
not vendored: the HTTP, WebSocket and OpenSSL transports, the auth layer, the server, examples and tests; cpp-httplib is not needed, and CXXMCP_ENABLE_HTTP/WEBSOCKET stay undefined.
ASCII-normalized: tool.hpp has box-drawing characters in one comment line, written as "-"; nlohmann/json.hpp has a copyright line with a u-umlaut (Bjoern Hoehrmann), written as "oe". No code changed.
